properties.notes: Brownfield site that is largely vacant although some buildings and hardstanding remain. Offers a good opportunity for redevelopment in the urban area. A planning permission was previously consented for scheme of 49 two- three- and four-bed dwellings but this has now lapsed (15/01941/FUL). Approximately half of the overall SHLAA sites was covered by that application. Potential still remains for redevelopment of the site in the longer-term. .
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
